scenarios.name: Escalating Global Trade Conflicts
scenarios.description: Intensified trade wars between the U.S. and major trading partners, leading to supply chain disruptions and increased tariffs.

impacts.explanation: Reduced exports and higher import costs would lower GDP.
Industries affected by tariffs may lay off workers.
Increased defense spending to counter trade threats.

scenarios.reasoning: High probability due to existing tensions with China and potential escalation. Base rates suggest 20% chance of major trade conflicts.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems
Look for the errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: Interest Rate Volatility Spike
scenarios.description: Federal Reserve raises rates aggressively to combat persistent inflation, triggering market uncertainty.

impacts.explanation: Higher Fed rates directly increase yields.
Higher borrowing costs reduce consumer spending.

scenarios.reasoning: Moderate probability if inflation remains above 4%, balancing outside view data against current policy track.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Energy Price Collapse
scenarios.description: A sudden drop in oil prices due to oversupply or alternative energy breakthroughs.

impacts.explanation: Lower energy costs reduce price pressures.
Lower import costs improve trade deficit.

scenarios.reasoning: Balanced probability considering recent energy market volatility and geopolitical risks.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overconfidence

scenarios.name: Housing Market Correction
scenarios.description: Federal Reserve policy shifts to caps housing stimulus, causing a slowdown in construction.

impacts.explanation: Restricted financing reduces new home construction.
Sector job losses in construction and real estate.

scenarios.reasoning: Lower probability due to current high starts growth, but potential if Fed signals restraint.
